# dsh-plugin-template

> Minimal, verified template for DeepSeek Harness plugins: bundle manifest, one tool, runtime peer guard, tests, and CI that really invokes the tool. Fork it and rename.

## Key facts

- Runtime guard: `assertPeerCompatible()` rejects silently-linked older `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` copies (discussion #1697)
- Verification: unit tests; packaged integration (pack → fresh host → register → real handler call → assert); CI boot smoke on Windows
- Includes `cordis.patch.yml`, `dsh.bundle`, `files` allowlist, `prepare` script

## Key files

- src/index.ts — plugin entry + hello tool
- src/version.ts — peer-version guard
- scripts/integration-test.mjs — packaged real-invocation smoke

## Community

- RFC #1629: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1629
